stage: P19 independent review and controlled browser verification

ownership.production: product_coverage: extraction/list/type preservation; architecture: scope/ArtifactPane/ThreadView entries; root: integration
ownership.independent: verification: real applyUpdate integration tests, full App WebKit/Chromium controlled IPC and receipts

counterexamples.case: Old pending tool settles in A; B reports same path; late completion belongs only to A; retract A with explicit [] leaves B unchanged; queue state and old draft remain unchanged.
ACP v1 nullable omitted fields preserve existing content/locations; explicit [] independently clears only that collection; no rawInput/prose fallback.

Missing referenced item, unknown scope, old scope missing reference never falls back to all/current; reordering loaded items preserves original item-ID membership; repeated reference never doubles source.

Nonstring location/diff paths cannot become actionable via String coercion; malformed detail remains available as raw evidence. Owner first records the normalization red; independent suite checks composition.
Decoded file URI and identical path dedup exactly, retain each current tool origin; relative and absolute aliases are not invented equal; moving or deleting report does not migrate opinions.
Location/link-only tool and round entry reachable; open list, pagination and source updates cause no file inspect/read/copy/open IPC until explicit action.
Thread/cwd/scope/hide/retraction and stale handler cannot inspect an unrelated or retired source; list refresh never changes existing opened version/draft.

Explicit file opening delegates exact path to existing wrapper; controlled missing/changed/read failure displays accurate failure and retains original drafts. Browser proves UI/mock contract only, not actual disk verification.
Same path new report/version retains old opinion path/contentId/anchor/text; take explicitly appends once to original composer and never sends.
Tab/Enter reach report list and file controls; narrow complete App stays in local scroll region; existing diff/output and return controls remain reachable.

executionRules: Wait for owner API and stable source before dependent tests/browser.
Keep first effective failures and exact source hashes; do not count build or harness errors as product regressions.
No production edit by reviewer; report concrete failing counterexamples to owner.
Preserve raw JSON bytes before formatting; final receipt links exact input and output hashes.
boundaries: No formal Farfold app, Agent prompt, account, live user DB or user file access.
Controlled browser IPC is not Tauri native, real filesystem or 29-Agent acceptance.
Existing Rust file/copy boundary evidence reused only if exact inputs unchanged; no new copy implementation.
No histories or disk scans; only currently loaded structured tool reports.
